- Methods Engineering Job responsibilities/description:
- Process development and optimization: Lead the development and implementation of improved manufacturing methods to increase efficiency and reduce waste.
- Team leadership and management: Supervise, mentor, and motivate a team of manufacturing professionals, fostering a culture of safety and continuous improvement.
- Quality and compliance: Ensure all operations comply with safety regulations, quality standards, and company policies.
- Strategic planning: Develop production strategies and master schedules to meet company goals, budgets, and timelines.
- Data analysis: Analyse production data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify areas for improvement and drive data-driven decision-making.
- Cross-functional collaboration: Work with other departments, such as engineering and supply chain, to resolve production issues and optimize workflows.
- Budget management: Oversee the manufacturing budget to ensure efficient allocation of resources.
- Technology implementation: Coordinate the implementation of new manufacturing technologies and automation. Job prerequisites:

EDUCATION:
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Manufacturing/Production/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Experience:
- 20+ years of experience with at least 5 years in a leadership role within the machine tools industry.
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field like Engineering or Production Management.
- Significant experience in manufacturing, with several years in a leadership role.
- Proven track record in process improvement, efficiency, and production management.
- Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
- Expertise in methodologies like Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma is often required.

- Home » Careers » Head of Application Engineering
- Department : Application Engineering
- Head of Application Engineering Primary objective:
- The Head of Application Engineering will lead the development and deployment of customized machining solutions to meet customer requirements. This role involves driving technical excellence, managing a skilled team, and collaborating with customers to ensure the successful application of machine tools in various industries. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in machining processes, tooling, and industry applications, combined with strong leadership capabilities. Job responsibilities/description: Customer Engagement:
- Collaborate with customers to understand their manufacturing challenges and requirements.
- Provide technical consultations and recommend optimal machine tools, tooling, and machining processes.
- Lead pre-sales technical discussions, including machine demonstrations, feasibility studies, and ROI analysis. Solution Development:
- Design and develop tailored machining solutions, including process optimization and cycle time reduction.
- Oversee the creation of part programs and process flows for customer components.
- Evaluate and recommend cutting tools, fixtures, and accessories to enhance productivity. Team Leadership:
- Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing application engineering team.
- Foster a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning within the team. Technical Support:
- Provide end-to-end support for machine installation, trials, and commissioning at customer sites.
- Troubleshoot machining issues and offer solutions to improve accuracy, surface finish, and throughput.
- Conduct training programs for customers and internal teams on machine usage, programming, and process optimization. Product Development Support:
- Collaborate with R&D and design teams to provide feedback on product performance and customer needs.
- Participate in new product development initiatives to ensure customer requirements are met. Market and Industry Insights:
- Stay updated on advancements in machining technologies, materials, and customer industries.
- Benchmark competitors and identify emerging trends to ensure the company remains a leader in application engineering. Key skill required:
- Proficiency in CNC programming (e.g., G-code, CAM software).
- In-depth knowledge of machining processes, materials, and cutting tools.
- Strong customer orientation with excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Leadership skills with the ability to motivate and guide a team.
- Analytical mindset for process evaluation and improvement.
- Certifications in CNC programming or advanced machining technologies. Job prerequisites:

EDUCATION:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field. Experience:
- 20+ years of experience in application engineering or machining solutions, with at least 5 years in a leadership role within the machine tools industry.
- Expertise in CNC machining, tooling selection, and process optimization across various industries such as automotive, aerospace, and industrial manufacturing.
- Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
- Reduction in customer cycle times and machining costs.
- Increase in successful project completions and customer satisfaction scores.
- Team development metrics, including skill enhancement and training milestones.
- Contribution to new business development through application engineering excellence.

- Head of Quality
- Home » Careers » Head of Quality
- Department : QA & QC
- Head of Quality Primary objective:
- The Head of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing quality assurance and control systems to ensure products meet industry standards, customer expectations, and regulatory compliance. This role requires a strategic leader with a deep understanding of quality management in the machine tools industry and a strong ability to foster a culture of continuous improvement. Job responsibilities/description: Quality Management System (QMS):
- Develop, implement, and maintain ISO 9001 or equivalent QMS standards.
- Establish and ensure adherence to quality policies, processes, and procedures across the organization. Product Quality Assurance:
- Define and monitor product quality standards, ensuring alignment with industry benchmarks.
- Lead quality audits and certifications for product compliance with relevant standards.
- Oversee first article inspections, in-process quality checks, and final product inspections. Supplier Quality Management:
- Assess and qualify suppliers, ensuring raw materials and components meet quality standards.
- Collaborate with procurement and supply chain teams to address supplier quality issues. Customer Satisfaction:
- Analyze customer feedback and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to address concerns.
- Lead the resolution of customer complaints, ensuring root cause analysis and sustainable solutions. Team Leadership:
- Build, train, and mentor a high-performing quality team.
- Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. Continuous Improvement:
- Drive initiatives such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Total Quality Management (TQM) to enhance efficiency and reduce defects.
- Analyze quality metrics to identify trends and implement improvement strategies. Regulatory Compliance:
- Ensure all quality and safety standards meet local and international regulations.
- Keep abreast of industry developments and regulatory changes, adapting practices accordingly. Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Work closely with R&D, manufacturing, and sales teams to ensure quality considerations are integral to new product development and production processes.
- Partner with engineering teams to resolve design and process issues impacting quality. Key skill required:

- Production Planning and
- Control (PPC) Primary objective:
- The Head of PPC is responsible for the strategic planning, scheduling, and coordination of production activities to ensure efficient utilization of resources, timely delivery, and alignment with business objectives. This role involves managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, optimizing production schedules, and driving continuous improvement in the manufacturing environment within the machine tools industry. Job responsibilities/description: Production Planning:
- Develop and implement robust production plans to meet customer demand while maintaining optimal inventory levels.
- Balance production capacity with market demand, ensuring timely delivery of machine tools.
- Collaborate with sales, R&D, and operations to forecast production requirements and manage lead times effectively. Scheduling and Coordination:
- Oversee the preparation of production schedules, considering machine loading, manpower, and material availability.
- Monitor production progress and resolve bottlenecks to maintain schedules.
- Ensure seamless coordination between departments, including procurement, quality, and manufacturing. Inventory and Material Management:
- Manage material planning processes, ensuring availability of raw materials and components without overstocking.
- Optimize inventory levels to reduce carrying costs and improve cash flow.
- Collaborate with procurement to maintain supplier relationships and mitigate material shortages. Process Optimization:
- Analyze production workflows and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce waste.
- Drive Lean Manufacturing or other process improvement methodologies within the PPC function.
- Implement advanced planning systems to streamline scheduling and resource allocation. Team Leadership:
- Lead and mentor the PPC team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
- Build cross-functional collaboration to align PPC objectives with organizational goals. Data Analysis and Reporting:
- Track production KPIs, including on-time delivery, capacity utilization, and production efficiency.
- Generate reports and insights to support strategic decision-making. Risk Management:
- Identify potential risks in production planning and implement contingency strategies.
- Ensure compliance with health, safety, and quality standards in all planning activities. Key skill required:
- Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, capacity planning, and supply chain management.
- Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems for production planning and inventory control.
- Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.
- Strong leadership and communication skills for managing teams and cross-functional collaboration.
- Ability to adapt to dynamic production requirements and changing customer demands. Job prerequisites:

EDUCATION:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Experience:
- 20+ years of experience in supply chain management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role within the machine tools or manufacturing industry.
- Proven track record of managing complex supply chains in a high-mix, low-volume environment.
- Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
- On-time delivery performance.
- Reduction in production lead times and inventory holding costs.
- Improved production capacity utilization.
- Accuracy of production schedules and material forecasts.

- Department : SCM
- Supply Chain
- Management (SCM) Primary objective:
- The Head of SCM is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the end-to-end supply chain processes to ensure cost efficiency, timely delivery, and superior quality. This includes procurement, inventory management, logistics, vendor management, and supply chain strategy. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, in-depth knowledge of supply chain practices in the machine tools industry, and a proven ability to align supply chain operations with business objectives. Job responsibilities/description: Strategic Planning and Execution:
- Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned with the company’s goals.
- Identify and mitigate risks across the supply chain to ensure business continuity.
- Drive initiatives to enhance supply chain agility, efficiency, and resilience. Procurement Management:
- Oversee procurement strategies to ensure cost-effective sourcing of raw materials and components.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, negotiating favorable terms.
- Evaluate and onboard new suppliers to reduce dependency and ensure quality. Inventory and Warehouse Management:
- Optimize inventory levels to balance availability with cost efficiency.
- Implement robust inventory tracking systems to minimize stockouts and excess stock.
- Ensure effective warehouse operations, including storage, handling, and dispatch. Logistics and Distribution:
- Manage logistics operations to ensure timely delivery of materials and finished products.
- Optimize transportation networks to reduce costs and improve reliability.
- Ensure compliance with import/export regulations and standards. Vendor Management:
- Establish performance metrics for vendors and conduct regular evaluations.
- Collaborate with vendors to improve quality, lead times, and delivery performance.
- Address vendor issues proactively to avoid disruptions. Process Improvement and Technology Adoption:
- Implement Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to enhance supply chain efficiency.
- Leverage digital tools such as ERP, MRP, and SCM software for process optimization.
- Drive automation and data-driven decision-making in supply chain operations. Team Leadership:
- Build, train, and manage a high-performing SCM team.
- Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Reporting and Analytics:
- Monitor and analyze supply chain performance using key metrics such as cost savings, lead times, and on-time delivery.
- Generate reports and insights for senior management to support strategic decision-making. Key skill required:
- In-depth knowledge of procurement, logistics, and inventory management principles.
- Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and supply chain analytics tools.
- Strong negotiation, communication, and leadership skills.
- Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
- Understanding of industry-specific challenges, including machining, tooling, and materials.
- Certifications (Preferred):
- Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) or Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM).
- Training in Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies. Job prerequisites:

EDUCATION:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Experience:
- 20+ years of experience in supply chain management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role within the machine tools or manufacturing industry.
- Proven track record of managing complex supply chains in a high-mix, low-volume environment.
- Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
- Reduction in supply chain costs.
- Improvement in on-time delivery performance.
- Reduction in inventory holding costs and stockouts.
- Vendor performance improvements (quality, cost, delivery).
